title: This is Not What I Voted For
description:
The FBI promised sweeping reform under Trump-aligned leadership. Kash Patel and Dan Bongino talked openly about transparency, accountability, and finally confronting the “deep state.”

But months later, Americans are still asking the same questions. Where are the arrests? Where is the accountability? Where is the visible change?
